datasets.name: endpoint_requests
queryLines:
WITH workspace_map AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name AS endpoint_name,
    w.workspace_name
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest w
        ON u.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
  WHERE
    u.billing_origin_product = 'MODEL_SERVING'
    AND u.record_type = 'ORIGINAL'
    AND u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  eu.request_time,
  eu.status_code,
  eu.input_token_count,
  eu.output_token_count,
  eu.requester,
  eu.request_streaming,
  se.endpoint_name,
  se.entity_type,
  se.entity_name,
  se.served_entity_name,
  se.created_by,
  se.task,
  se.endpoint_delete_time,
  wm.workspace_name
FROM
  system.serving.endpoint_usage eu
    JOIN system.serving.served_entities se
      ON eu.served_entity_id = se.served_entity_id
    LEFT JOIN workspace_map wm
      ON se.endpoint_name = wm.endpoint_name

datasets.name: app_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  usage_metadata.app_name AS app_name,
  ANY_VALUE(identity_metadata.created_by) AS owner,
  MAX(usage_date) AS last_active_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT usage_date) AS active_days,
  SUM(usage_quantity) AS total_dbus,
  MIN(usage_date) AS first_active_date
FROM
  system.billing.usage
WHERE
  billing_origin_product = 'APPS'
  AND record_type = 'ORIGINAL'
GROUP BY
  usage_metadata.app_name

columns.description: Whether app has had no usage in last 7 days
columns.expression: CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), last_active_date) > 7 THEN 'Idle' ELSE 'Active' END

columns.description: Percentage of days active between first and last usage

datasets.name: app_audit
queryLines:
SELECT
  user_identity.email AS user_email,
  action_name,
  request_params['app_name'] AS app_name,
  event_date,
  event_time,
  response.status_code AS status_code
FROM
  system.access.audit
WHERE
  service_name = 'apps'
  AND user_identity.email IS NOT NULL

columns.description: Grouped action categories for cleaner visualization
columns.expression: CASE WHEN action_name IN ('deployApp', 'createUpdate') THEN 'Deploy' WHEN action_name IN ('createApp', 'installTemplateApp') THEN 'Create' WHEN action_name IN ('startApp', 'stopApp') THEN 'Start/Stop' WHEN action_name = 'deleteApp' THEN 'Delete' WHEN action_name IN ('updateApp', 'changeAppsAcl') THEN 'Configure' ELSE 'Other' END

datasets.name: all_endpoints
queryLines:
WITH workspace_map AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name AS endpoint_name,
    w.workspace_name
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest w
        ON u.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
  WHERE
    u.billing_origin_product = 'MODEL_SERVING'
    AND u.record_type = 'ORIGINAL'
    AND u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  se.endpoint_name,
  se.endpoint_id,
  CASE
    WHEN se.endpoint_delete_time IS NOT NULL THEN 'Deleted'
    ELSE 'Active'
  END AS status,
  wm.workspace_name
FROM
  system.serving.served_entities se
    LEFT JOIN workspace_map wm
      ON se.endpoint_name = wm.endpoint_name

datasets.name: ml_billing
queryLines:
SELECT
  u.usage_date,
  u.sku_name,
  u.usage_quantity,
  u.billing_origin_product,
  u.usage_type,
  u.usage_metadata.endpoint_name AS endpoint_name,
  u.usage_metadata.endpoint_id AS endpoint_id,
  u.identity_metadata.run_as AS run_as_user,
  u.workspace_id,
  w.workspace_name,
  p.pricing.default AS list_price,
  u.usage_quantity * COALESCE(p.pricing.default, 0) AS estimated_cost
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
    LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices p
      ON u.cloud = p.cloud
      AND u.sku_name = p.sku_name
      AND u.usage_start_time >= p.price_start_time
      AND (
        u.usage_start_time < p.price_end_time
        OR p.price_end_time IS NULL
      )
    LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest w
      ON u.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
WHERE
  u.record_type = 'ORIGINAL'
  AND u.billing_origin_product = 'MODEL_SERVING'

datasets.name: apps_billing
queryLines:
SELECT
  u.usage_date,
  u.sku_name,
  u.usage_quantity,
  u.billing_origin_product,
  u.usage_type,
  u.usage_metadata.app_name AS app_name,
  u.usage_metadata.app_id AS app_id,
  u.identity_metadata.created_by AS created_by,
  p.pricing.default AS list_price,
  u.usage_quantity * COALESCE(p.pricing.default, 0) AS estimated_cost
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
    LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices p
      ON u.cloud = p.cloud
      AND u.sku_name = p.sku_name
      AND u.usage_start_time >= p.price_start_time
      AND (
        u.usage_start_time < p.price_end_time
        OR p.price_end_time IS NULL
      )
WHERE
  u.record_type = 'ORIGINAL'
  AND u.billing_origin_product = 'APPS'
